summary: Round-2 re-verify of f3a7f017: both round-1 blockers CLOSED. P0 (catalog↔instance-detail divergence): the live-node resolver was extracted to the pure core (src/core/process-catalog-view.ts:420 resolveLiveNodesByInstance) and is now the SINGLE source called by BOTH the catalog (process-catalog.ts:357) AND the list+detail routes (processes.ts:419). /api/processes/:id now serializes projectionToInstance(overlaid) (processes.ts:616) instead of the frozen (match) — node/nodes reflect the live token, not the snapshot; the old duplicate resolver was removed from process-catalog.ts. Catalog + list + detail = one live source, divergence structurally impossible. P1 (arbitrary tasks[0] on AND-split): pickPrimaryLiveNode sorts by intrinsic key (taskDefinitionKey→id→name), never response order; >1 active ⇒ ambiguous:true + full concurrentSteps per the AMBIGUOUS_ACTIVE_TASK precedent (surface-not-refuse for a display overlay). P2: shared LIVE_OVERLAY_DEADLINE_MS=2000 wall-clock budget caps the fan-out; a slow-but-alive engine degrades to snapshot. processes.ts stays pg-free (FF-7-3 PASS live). All specified gates green; +17 tests all load-bearing (order-independence proven forward-vs-reversed, deadline proven against a real 60s hang, single-source proven catalog==detail from one task set).

round1_findings_status.resolution: One resolveLiveNodesByInstance def in core (process-catalog-view.ts:420); two call sites (process-catalog.ts:357, processes.ts:419) — verified by grep. List route overlays before mapping (processes.ts:533); detail route overlays the matched projection and serializes projectionToInstance(overlaid) at line 616 (was projectionToInstance(match)). No frozen node/nodes path remains. overlayLiveSteps also overlays concurrentSteps (→ detail nodes) only for projections carrying the field, keeping the catalog path byte-identical. Single-source invariant pinned by the 'catalog ↔ detail derive the SAME live node from ONE source' test.

pickPrimaryLiveNode (process-catalog-view.ts:344) sorts a copy by (taskDefinitionKey, id, name) — total stable function of the data, not Flowable response order. >1 active ⇒ ambiguous:true + all branches in concurrentSteps. Determinism proven non-tautologically: forward and reversed array orderings of the same AND-split yield byte-identical output; tie tests prove id-then-name fallback.

Shared wall-clock deadline (LIVE_OVERLAY_DEADLINE_MS=2000) passed by both callers; per-instance calls race the remaining budget, a loser keeps its snapshot (atomic per instance — no torn node). Proven against a real 60s-hang stub capped to ~30ms; already-elapsed budget skips the call with zero added latency.

adversarial_probes.a_single_source: PASS — one core resolver, both surfaces call it; old duplicate removed; :id serializes overlaid not frozen match.
adversarial_probes.b_primary_determinism: PASS — intrinsic-key sort; forward==reversed test proves order-independence; ties stable.
adversarial_probes.c_degrade_both_honest: PASS — engine down/error/no-task/deadline → snapshot on BOTH, 200 not 500; per-instance atomic; total outage → empty map → all snapshots.
adversarial_probes.d_pg_free_isolation: PASS — start-route-isolation FF-7-3 green; processes.ts imports only core/*, no pg (only comment mentions).
adversarial_probes.e_tenant_scope: PASS — inst ids from tenant-scoped listInstanceProjections; detail overlays only the single tenant-matched projection; no cross-tenant surface added.

non_blocking.title: LIVE_OVERLAY_DEADLINE_MS declared twice (process-catalog.ts export + processes.ts local const)
non_blocking.detail: Intentional and documented (processes.ts:38): importing the value from process-catalog.ts would pull pg into the display-plane module and trip FF-7-3. Minor drift risk. Follow-up: hoist the constant into the pure core so both import ONE pg-free value.

non_blocking.title: Engine-down vs no-active-task indistinguishable in logs (carried from round 1)
non_blocking.detail: resolveLiveNodesByInstance omits the key identically for !result.ok, a throw, and a deadline-loss. Honest to the user, opaque to operators. Optional debug counter on !result.ok would make a real outage observable.
